description: Backend Part A (Type B pricing + multi-quote) and Part B (disintermediation state machine) in lambdas/collect/app.py, including the two MEDIUM fixes and the mark_done NIT#3 comment. This is the correctness core: it establishes the module constants, the pricing/quote path, and the state machine that gates contact/chat behind a 'confirmed' status. It also adds the collector-module scaffolding (COLLECTORS_TABLE/COLLECTOR_DOCS_BUCKET reads, s3 client, DOC_TYPES) and a forward-reference-safe _is_approved_collector gate call-site so FEAT-003 can fill in the body. Depends on FEAT-001 only at deploy time (env vars); the code imports fine without them (defaults to '').
steps: In lambdas/collect/app.py add module constants (single source of truth): UNLOCK_STATUSES = ('confirmed','collected','disputed'); CHAT_STATUSES = UNLOCK_STATUSES; LIVE_QUOTE_STATUSES = ('requested','accepted','confirmed'). Add a comment that 'collecting' is a WASTE-ITEM status only and never a collect-request status. IGNORE the design's historical revision-2 block that lists a 4-element tuple with 'collecting'.

Add _dec_price(v): parse to a non-negative Decimal quantized to 2dp, else None (blank/invalid/negative -> None). Add _validate_quote(amount, max_price): returns (ok, error) — None/<=0 -> (False,'A quote amount greater than 0 is required'); max_price not None and amount>max_price -> (False,"Quote exceeds the owner's maximum price"); else (True,None).

Add collector-module scaffolding near the top: COLLECTORS_TABLE/COLLECTOR_DOCS_BUCKET from os.environ (default ''), collectors_table = dynamodb.Table(COLLECTORS_TABLE) if COLLECTORS_TABLE else None, s3 = boto3.client('s3', region_name=REGION), DOC_TYPES = {'registration','license','insurance'}. Add _get_collector(user_id) (get_item on collectors_table, None on error) and _is_approved_collector(user_id) (True only if a record exists and status=='approved' — fails closed). FEAT-003 extends the collector routes; these two helpers are needed by request_collect here.

create_report: read priceType (default 'user_pays'), currency ([:3].upper(), default 'MYR'), maxPrice via _dec_price; always set item['priceType'] and item['currency']; set item['maxPrice'] only when non-None. Backward-compatible with old items.
public_view: add priceType (default 'user_pays'), maxPrice (if present), currency (default 'MYR') for BOTH owner and non-owner. Do not change address masking.

request_collect: enforce the pinned 9-step order — (1) missing id 400, (2) no table 503, (3) waste None 404, (4) self-collect 400 'You cannot collect your own item' (EXISTING, kept, BEFORE the collector gate), (5) item not open 409 'This item is no longer available' (EXISTING, kept), (6) collector gate: if (waste.get('priceType') or 'user_pays')=='user_pays' and not _is_approved_collector(sub) -> 403 'Only verified collector businesses can quote on paid pickups', (7) read quoteAmount via _dec_price + message [:500], then _validate_quote(amount, _dec_price(waste.get('maxPrice'))) -> 400 on not-ok, (8) duplicate-live-quote: paginated wasteIndex query (NO Limit, loop LastEvaluatedKey) filtered in Lambda to collectorId==sub and status in LIVE_QUOTE_STATUSES -> 409 'You already have a live quote on this item', (9) persist status 'requested' snapshotting quoteAmount (Decimal), currency (from waste, default MYR), maxPrice (from waste if present), message. REMOVE ENTIRELY the existing table.update_item that flipped the waste item to 'requested'. Keep the owner notify('request',...). Return _creq_view(cr) with no waste.

_creq_view: ALWAYS expose quoteAmount, currency, maxPrice, paymentStatus (plus existing message) — never gated by unlock. Change the unlock condition from status=='approved' to (status in UNLOCK_STATUSES and waste); only then set unlocked=True and copy fullAddress/ownerPhone/pickupTime/notes.

approve_request: keep guard (owner, status 'requested'); set status 'accepted' (was 'approved'); REMOVE the waste-item flip to 'collecting' and the 'address unlocked' notification; new collector notify: 'Your quote was accepted — awaiting the owner's confirmation.'; return _creq_view(cr) with NO waste; does NOT auto-close other quotes.
reject_request: keep guard (owner, status 'requested'); set 'rejected'; REMOVE the unconditional table.update_item that reopened the waste item to 'open' — touch ONLY the collect-request row.

mark_done: change guard from status!='approved' to status not in ('confirmed',) (else 400); on success set collect-request 'collected' (+completedAt=int(time.time())) and waste item 'collected'; NIT#3: add a one-line comment that the waste-item write is an UNCONDITIONAL set to 'collected' regardless of its prior status.
_chat_enabled: return cr.get('status') in CHAT_STATUSES (was ('approved','collected')). Leave get_messages/send_message/list_conversations logic unchanged — they inherit the stricter gate.

list_requests: in BOTH the incoming and outgoing loops change the waste-load gate from 'if cr.get("status") == "approved"' to 'if cr.get("status") in UNLOCK_STATUSES' (CRITICAL — else confirmed deals get waste=None and never unlock).

Add confirm_deal (NEW function, for the /confirm suffix) with MEDIUM-1 semantics: guard caller is owner and status 'accepted' (else 409). At the TOP re-load the waste item and return 409 'This item already has a confirmed collector' if waste.status=='collecting' and waste.collectorId is set and differs from this request's collectorId. WRITE ORDER: (1) set collect-request status 'confirmed', confirmedAt=int(time.time()), paymentStatus='not_required'  # Phase 2: Stripe PaymentIntent authorization goes here; (2) set waste item 'collecting' + collectorId + collectorName — if THIS write fails return 500 WITHOUT returning the unlocked _creq_view (do the waste-item write before building the unlocked view); (3) BEST-EFFORT auto-close (try/except, logged, MUST NOT fail the confirm): paginated wasteIndex query moving every OTHER request for this wasteId with status in ('requested','accepted') to 'closed', notifying each losing collector 'Another collector was selected'. Add inline comments that 'collecting' is a waste-item status only. Notify the chosen collector 'Deal confirmed — address and contact unlocked, chat is open.' reusing the 'approved' push type. Return _creq_view(cr, _get_waste(cr['wasteId'])).

Add cancel_request (NEW, for /cancel) — soft status, NEVER deletes: pre-confirm (requested/accepted) either member -> 'cancelled' + cancelledAt, waste untouched; post-confirm (confirmed) either member -> 'cancelled' + cancelledAt, then MEDIUM-2: run a paginated wasteIndex query (NO Limit, loop LastEvaluatedKey) filtering collect-request status=='confirmed' and EXCLUDING the row being cancelled, and revert the waste item to 'open' ONLY IF zero other confirmed deals exist; add a one-line comment 'Auto-closed losing quotes are NOT restored on cancel; owner re-lists and collectors re-quote'; leave paymentStatus as-is behind '# Phase 2: trigger Stripe refund/void here'; notify both parties; collected/rejected/closed/disputed/cancelled -> 409.

Add raise_dispute (NEW, for /dispute): guard caller is _is_member and status in ('confirmed','collected') (else 409; 'disputed' excluded so it can't be re-raised); set status 'disputed', disputeReason=_s(body.get('reason'))[:1000], disputedAt=int(time.time()), disputedBy=sub; notify the other party; '# Phase 2: refund/arbitration hooks attach here'. Records+notifies only — no refund, no delete.
acceptance_criteria: lambdas/collect/app.py imports cleanly under the tests/conftest.py stubs (pytest collection succeeds).
UNLOCK_STATUSES == CHAT_STATUSES == ('confirmed','collected','disputed') and LIVE_QUOTE_STATUSES == ('requested','accepted','confirmed'); 'collecting' appears in NEITHER.

approve_request sets 'accepted', unlocks nothing, and returns _creq_view with no waste; _creq_view unlocks only when status in UNLOCK_STATUSES and a waste object is present; both list_requests loops load the waste item on 'in UNLOCK_STATUSES'.

confirm_deal enforces one-confirmed-deal-per-item (409 on a differing existing collector), writes collect-request before waste item, returns 500 without unlocking if the waste write fails, and auto-close is best-effort (never fails the confirm).

cancel_request and raise_dispute change status only (no DynamoDB delete); post-confirm cancel reverts the waste item to 'open' only when a paginated query finds no other confirmed deal; no payment code moves money.
The disintermediation invariant holds: no code path exposes fullAddress/phone or enables chat before status 'confirmed'. Existing pytest suite still passes.
verification: From the worktree root run 'pytest -q' and confirm all existing unit tests still pass (FEAT-004 adds the new assertions; this FEAT must not break collection/import).

Re-read _creq_view, _chat_enabled, approve_request, confirm_deal, and BOTH list_requests call-sites and confirm the invariant: nothing unlocks before 'confirmed', approve_request passes no waste, list_requests gates waste-load on 'in UNLOCK_STATUSES'.
Grep lambdas/collect/app.py to confirm no new real-payment code: only paymentStatus='not_required' and '# Phase 2' comments; confirm_deal has no payment precondition.
findings: Implemented in lambdas/collect/app.py. NEW functions FEAT-003 must wire into the dispatcher (currently NOT wired — handler left untouched per task): confirm_deal(claims, body) for the '/confirm' POST suffix; cancel_request(claims, body) for '/cancel'; raise_dispute(claims, body) for '/dispute'. All three take (claims, body) and read body['collectRequestId'] (raise_dispute also reads body['reason']); each returns a dict or a Response, so wrap with _unwrap(...) exactly like the existing POST branches. Add these three to the endswith chain alongside the existing report/request/approve/reject/done branches. Order within the suffix chain is safe (no collisions among confirm/cancel/dispute). The '/admin/' and '/collector/' PREFIX dispatch (dispatch_admin/dispatch_collector/dispatch_admin_get/dispatch_collector_get) is still FEAT-003's to add IN FRONT of the endswith chain so '/admin/collectors/{id}/approve' is not captured by endswith('approve'). Collector scaffolding already present and importable: COLLECTORS_TABLE, COLLECTOR_DOCS_BUCKET, collectors_table, s3, DOC_TYPES, _get_collector(user_id), _is_approved_collector(user_id) (fails closed). request_collect now calls _is_approved_collector at step 6 for user_pays listings. Module constants live as single source of truth: UNLOCK_STATUSES == CHAT_STATUSES == ('confirmed','collected','disputed'), LIVE_QUOTE_STATUSES == ('requested','accepted','confirmed'); 'collecting' is waste-item-only. approve_request now sets 'accepted' (reuses 'request' push type for the acceptance notice). confirm_deal reuses the 'approved' push type for the unlock notice. NOTE: one existing test (tests/test_collect.py::test_creq_view_unlocks_when_approved) was updated to use status 'confirmed' instead of 'approved' to match the new unlock point; FEAT-004 can expand the quote/state-machine assertions from there. All 30 tests pass (pytest -q). No real payments: paymentStatus='not_required' + '# Phase 2' comments only.
